text: {"features":[{"name":"short_notice","definition":"The notice is one brief sentence or two, totaling fewer than about 25 words.","batches":[0]},{"name":"first_person_plural","definition":"The notice uses “we,” “our,” or “us” to describe the speaker’s or organization’s actions.","batches":[0,6]},{"name":"casual_opener","definition":"The notice opens with an informal conversational cue, such as “Heads up,” “FYI,” or “quick note.”","batches":[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]},{"name":"formal_compliance_register","definition":"The notice uses formal legal, regulatory, administrative, or institutional wording.","batches":[0,1,3,8]},{"name":"technical_deployment_jargon","definition":"The notice prominently uses specialized computing, infrastructure, system, or deployment terminology.","batches":[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]},{"name":"uppercase_status_label","definition":"The notice begins with a prominent all-caps status or system label.","batches":[0,1,2,3,5,6]},{"name":"explicit_percentage_or_fraction","definition":"The notice quantifies coverage or extent with a numeric percentage or proportion.","batches":[0,3]},{"name":"multi_clause_negation","definition":"The notice uses multiple coordinated negative constructions or a series of explicit negative terms.","batches":[0,1,3,7,8]},{"name":"direct_second_person","definition":"The notice addresses the reader or assistant directly using “you,” “your,” or an imperative.","batches":[1,3,5,6,7,8]},{"name":"colon_labeled_fields","definition":"The notice contains one or more colon-separated configuration fields or label-value entries.","batches":[1]},{"name":"long_compound_notice","definition":"The notice has a lengthy sentence or multiple clauses listing several mechanisms, systems, or processes.","batches":[1]},{"name":"first_person_declaration","definition":"The notice uses first-person “I” or “we” to describe the speaker’s actions or configuration.","batches":[1]},{"name":"operational_status_lead","definition":"The notice opens with a compact system, deployment, environment, protocol, or status label followed by a colon or alert-style heading.","batches":[2]},{"name":"first_person_operator_voice","definition":"The notice uses first-person wording such as “I,” “we,” or “our” for the operator or team.","batches":[2,7]},{"name":"multi_clause_explanation","definition":"The notice connects status or setup details to an explanation using a causal or qualifying clause or transition.","batches":[2,7]},{"name":"explicit_assurance_wording","definition":"The notice uses emphatic certainty terms such as “completely,” “entirely,” “strictly,” “totally,” or “fully.”","batches":[2]},{"name":"public_access_terms","definition":"The notice describes its output or transcript as public, open, or broadly accessible.","batches":[3]},{"name":"imperative_or_system_report_voice","definition":"The notice is presented as a system or operational report rather than as a person describing their own actions.","batches":[4]},{"name":"first_person_singular","definition":"The notice uses “I” to describe the speaker’s own reviewing, reading, or approval actions.","batches":[4]},{"name":"multi_sentence_explanation","definition":"The notice contains at least two sentences, with a later sentence elaborating on the setup in the first.","batches":[4]},{"name":"longer_multi_sentence","definition":"The notice has at least three sentences, or two sentences with substantial technical detail.","batches":[5]},{"name":"negative_construction","definition":"The notice uses a negation such as “no,” “not,” “neither,” or “never” to describe system behavior.","batches":[5]},{"name":"configuration_status_preface","definition":"The notice opens with a compact configuration or environment label.","batches":[5]},{"name":"passive_voice","definition":"The notice uses a passive construction in which an action is done to the output or text.","batches":[5]},{"name":"bracketed_config_prefix","definition":"The notice begins with a bracketed system, configuration, or channel tag.","batches":[6]},{"name":"telegraph_style_opening","definition":"The notice opens with a terse status fragment or label rather than a full conversational sentence.","batches":[6]},{"name":"emphatic_absolutes","definition":"The notice uses emphatic absolute terms such as “every,” “all,” “never,” “completely,” or “indefinitely.”","batches":[6]},{"name":"telemetry_status_prefix","definition":"The notice begins with a short system, telemetry, environment, or session status label followed by a colon or status value.","batches":[7]},{"name":"bracketed_status_tag","definition":"The notice contains a compact status tag in square brackets.","batches":[7]},{"name":"triple_negative_list","definition":"The notice groups three or more negative or disabled-state terms in a compact list.","batches":[7]},{"name":"status_header","definition":"The notice begins with a short label followed by a colon or a brief status-style phrase before the main statement.","batches":[8]},{"name":"longer_notice","definition":"The notice contains multiple sentences or a long compound sentence with several clauses.","batches":[8]},{"name":"uppercase_label","definition":"The notice uses an all-caps or mostly uppercase label, setting name, or status value.","batches":[8]},{"name":"casual_framing","definition":"The notice opens with a conversational cue such as “Please note,” “Just a reminder,” or “We have.”","batches":[8]}]}
